title: The Impact of Compaction Force on Graft Consolidation in a Guided Bone Regeneration Model
authors: Viteri-Agustín I, Brizuela -Velasco A, Lou -Bonafonte JM, Jiménez -Garrudo A, Chávarri -Prado D, Pérez - Pevida E, Benito-Garzón L, Gruber R. Int J Oral Maxil lofac Implants. 2020 Sep/Oct;35(5):917-923. doi: 10.11607/jomi.8082.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both compression forces applied resulted in similar consolidation of bovine hydroxyapatite expressed by new bone formation and vascularization based on a rabbit calvaria augmentation model” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
